root_text: Following the detection of India's first HMPV case in Bengaluru and reports of a virus outbreak in China, stock market investors took a cautious approach, with the Sensex falling over 800 points and Nifty losing more than 1%.

nodes.text: Following the detection of India's first HMPV case in Bengaluru and reports of a virus outbreak in China, stock market investors took a cautious approach, with the Sensex falling over 800 points and Nifty losing more than 1%.

nodes.author: spselvablogg
nodes.text: The health ministry has confirmed two cases of Human  Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Karnataka. Both cases were identified through  routine surveillance for respiratory viral pathogens. The affected  infants, with no history of international travel, are recovering.

nodes.author: spselvablogg
nodes.text:
The  ministry emphasizes that there is no unusual surge in respiratory  illnesses associated with HMPV in India.
